name: Trim Clear Topcoat — Template
intent: One clear topcoat. Sand after coat only if another coat follows (coat_lt_ctx:'clear_coats'). Repeats per ctx.clear_coats via scenario.dynamic_coats. Extended by per-substrate MOD_APPLY_<substrate>_CLEAR modules.
doctrine: Stain side defaults height:false uniformly across all 14 trim substrates. Sand-clear only fires when a follow-on clear coat will go over it (coat_lt_ctx:'clear_coats').
